[SWS_DM_01213] Set DynamicAccessList
⌈
If the application calls the
ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle::Set method of the class ara:-
:diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle, the Diagnostic Server instance
shall replace the DynamicAccessList of the authenticated client with the DynamicAc-
cessList passed by the application.
⌋
